claim_scope: Repository-disjoint development mechanism gate under the frozen boundary-v5 measurement correction.
research_question: Does Agent-visible clean replay improve Official EnvBench Pass@1 beyond the same strong Agent and the same public goal, and is any gain caused by feedback-conditioned repair rather than certification-aware construction alone?

selection.policy: Carry forward the four still-unopened repositories at case positions 2-5 and episode positions 4-15 from the outcome-blind boundary-v3 schedule; do not resample after the consumed distutils boundary calibration.
selection.identity_audit_result: Zero run-artifact matches for all four selected case IDs.

controlled_factors.host: mac for every Agent episode to avoid host-by-treatment confounding

resource_policy.interpretation: Operational safety cap only; success is not stopped by token or estimated monetary cost.
resource_policy.token_cost_and_wall_time: Measured and reported as secondary outcomes.
resource_policy.spark_role: Independent frozen-code verification, source/cache infrastructure, and post-run analysis; no Agent arm is moved to Spark in this gate.

mechanism_decision.certification_aware_construction: Compare paired A versus B Official Pass@1.
mechanism_decision.feedback_conditioned_repair: Count only when C has a first replay Fail or Unknown, submits a different later program in the same Agent session, obtains a passing clean replay, and terminates with Official Pass.
mechanism_decision.dormant_loop: If every C first replay passes, do not claim iterative repair and do not add structured state.
mechanism_decision.no_mechanism_gain: If C does not improve over A/B or no valid feedback-conditioned repair occurs, reject the current Minimal B mechanism hypothesis for this gate.
mechanism_decision.next_algorithm_change: Allowed only after all effective episodes finish and aggregate trajectory analysis identifies a repeated failure mode.

validity_policy.boundary_or_runner_hash_change: Stop the gate and preregister a new version before opening another case.
validity_policy.infrastructure_failure: Record as Unknown, preserve artifacts, and use only a preregistered infrastructure retry with identical treatment semantics.
validity_policy.network_retry: Allowed only for evidenced transport failure; no trajectory or outcome-dependent prompt changes.
validity_policy.schedule_order: Preserve the inherited ABC, ABC, CAB, BCA rotations and per-repository seeds.
